test_CEscape: test the CEscape function to escape bytes into C-style escaped string representations
test_CUnescape: test the CUnescape function to unescape C-style escaped strings back into raw bytes
run_TextEncodingTestCase: run the TextEncodingTestCase unittest suite to verify text encoding and decoding behavior
review_CEscape_CUnescape: review the CEscape and CUnescape functions for correct handling of escape sequences
summarize_TEXT_VALUES: summarize the TEST_VALUES tuples containing escaped strings and their unescaped byte equivalents
